9: # Twitter/X Automation
10: 
11: Automate Twitter/X via [inference.sh](https://inference.sh) CLI.
12: 
13: ![Twitter/X Automation](https://cloud.inference.sh/app/files/u/4mg21r6ta37mpaz6ktzwtt8krr/01kgad3pxsh3z3hnfpjyjpx4x4.jpeg)
14: 
15: ## Quick Start
16: 
17: > Requires inference.sh CLI (`belt`). [Install instructions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inference-sh/skills/refs/heads/main/cli-install.md)
18: 
19: ```bash
20: belt login
21: 
22: # Post a tweet
23: belt app run x/post-tweet --input '{"text": "Hello from inference.sh!"}'
24: ```
25: 
26: 
27: ## Available Apps
28: 
29: | App | App ID | Description |
30: |-----|--------|-------------|
31: | Post Tweet | `x/post-tweet` | Post text tweets |
32: | Create Post | `x/post-create` | Post with media |
33: | Like Post | `x/post-like` | Like a tweet |
34: | Retweet | `x/post-retweet` | Retweet a post |
35: | Delete Post | `x/post-delete` | Delete a tweet |
36: | Get Post | `x/post-get` | Get tweet by ID |
37: | Send DM | `x/dm-send` | Send direct message |
38: | Follow User | `x/user-follow` | Follow a user |
39: | Get User | `x/user-get` | Get user profile |
40: 
41: ## Examples
42: 
43: ### Post a Tweet
44: 
45: ```bash
46: belt app run x/post-tweet --input '{"text": "Just shipped a new feature! 🚀"}'
47: ```
48: 
49: ### Post with Media
50: 
51: ```bash
52: belt app sample x/post-create --save input.json
53: 
54: # Edit input.json:
55: # {
56: #   "text": "Check out this AI-generated image!",
57: #   "media_url": "https://your-image-url.jpg"
58: # }
59: 
60: belt app run x/post-create --input input.json
61: ```
62: 
63: ### Like a Tweet
64: 
65: ```bash
66: belt app run x/post-like --input '{"tweet_id": "1234567890"}'
67: ```
68: 
69: ### Retweet
70: 
71: ```bash
72: belt app run x/post-retweet --input '{"tweet_id": "1234567890"}'
73: ```
74: 
75: ### Send a DM
76: 
77: ```bash
78: belt app run x/dm-send --input '{
79:   "recipient_id": "user_id_here",
80:   "text": "Hey! Thanks for the follow."
81: }'
82: ```
83: 
84: ### Follow a User
85: 
86: ```bash
87: belt app run x/user-follow --input '{"username": "elonmusk"}'
88: ```
89: 
90: ### Get User Profile
91: 
92: ```bash
93: belt app run x/user-get --input '{"username": "OpenAI"}'
94: ```
95: 
96: ### Get Tweet Details
97: 
98: ```bash
99: belt app run x/post-get --input '{"tweet_id": "1234567890"}'
100: ```
101: 
102: ### Delete a Tweet
103: 
104: ```bash
105: belt app run x/post-delete --input '{"tweet_id": "1234567890"}'
106: ```
107: 
108: ## Workflow: Generate AI Image and Post
109: 
110: ```bash
111: # 1. Generate image
112: belt app run falai/flux-dev-lora --input '{"prompt": "sunset over mountains"}' > image.json
113: 
114: # 2. Post to Twitter with the image URL
115: belt app run x/post-create --input '{
116:   "text": "AI-generated art of a sunset 🌅",
117:   "media_url": "<image-url-from-step-1>"
118: }'
119: ```
120: 
121: ## Workflow: Generate and Post Video
122: 
123: ```bash
124: # 1. Generate video
125: belt app run google/veo-3-1-fast --input '{"prompt": "waves on a beach"}' > video.json
126: 
127: # 2. Post to Twitter
128: belt app run x/post-create --input '{
129:   "text": "AI-generated video 🎬",
130:   "media_url": "<video-url-from-step-1>"
131: }'
132: ```
133: 
134: ## Related Skills
135: 
136: ```bash
137: # Full platform skill (all apps)
138: npx skills add inference-sh/skills@infsh-cli
139: 
140: # Image generation (create images to post)
141: npx skills add inference-sh/skills@ai-image-generation
142: 
143: # Video generation (create videos to post)
144: npx skills add inference-sh/skills@ai-video-generation
145: 
146: # AI avatars (create presenter videos)
147: npx skills add inference-sh/skills@ai-avatar-video
148: ```
149: 
150: Browse all apps: `belt app list`
151:

153: 
154: - [X.com Integration](https://inference.sh/docs/integrations/x) - Setting up Twitter/X integration
155: - [X.com Integration Example](https://inference.sh/docs/examples/x-integration) - Complete Twitter workflow
156: - [Apps Overview](https://inference.sh/docs/apps/overview) - Understanding the app ecosystem
